purpose: Qualify a replacement for the existing required CI secret scanner; add no gate or local hook.

creddata.configs: Each arm's release default; exclude no labelled class and use identical scan limits. No author's modified-config arm.
creddata.harness: Samsung/CredData native benchmark; no replacement scorer/runner.
creddata.scoring_blocker: Current legacy Gitleaks adapter passes empty rule; current scorer requires native Category equality. Field-only conversion is invalid. Metadata-category projection or historical scorer needs an explicit contract decision.

repository_history.classification: Native location differences; unknown findings are not false positives until reviewed.

controls.selection: GitleaksConfigContextRestrictionTests, unchanged for both native binaries; isolated alias gitleaks for Betterleaks.
controls.separate_class: Unprefixed 40-hex controls d2, d4, d5; preserve all failures/errors/skips; accept none silently.
controls.class: synthetic/local integration; not upstream scanner acceptance

scan_envelope.completion: Exit0 plus newly written nonempty valid JSON report; retain crashes/errors/timeouts. Findings are not inferred from exit status alone.
scan_envelope.measurements: GNU time wall/max RSS; strace network syscall observations of each scanner child. Configuration-off is not zero-network evidence.
scan_envelope.observer: Ubuntu strace 6.19+ds-0ubuntu5 package extracted to isolated cache, no host installation.
scan_envelope.concurrency: One heavy step at a time. Dataset attempt starts only with a settled scoring route, outer resource envelope and sufficient time before paper window.

matching.identity: Path, exact start/end lines, native columns; git history also full commit. Never rule ID. Preserve line-span collapse separately.
matching.adapter: tools/qualification/creddata_locations.py validates/projects modern native JSON to location metadata only. It does not score or invoke scanners.
matching.limitations: Column units are retained, not converted to CredData offsets. Native scorer's unknown/lost findings do not enter FP; same-span value/label ambiguity and class weighting need explicit accounting. No tolerance/fallback/category oracle.

required: Complete pinned corpus and valid unchanged upstream scoring contract
acceptance.gate_swap: Separate lane:shared PR after owner decision and cross-family read; this foundation draft changes no required workflow/hook/settings.
acceptance.interim: CI secret scan only; no local hook
